notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue: the half with rows f-j (top of the picture) is bank 'b', and the half with rows a-e is bank 't'. Rail hole numbers (bp.1, bp.3, bn.1, bn.7) are approximate. Each rail is one strip, so the exact number does not change the connectivity.

The pushbutton straddles the centre gap at columns 4 and 6. I assumed the pairs joined inside it are the two legs in the same column. So side 1 is column 4 (5V side) and side 2 is column 6 (pin 2 and resistor side). This matches the schematic, where the switch sits between 5V and the pin 2 / pull-down node.

The 10k resistor is on the same side as the input pin (column 6). It runs to column 9, which a black jumper wire connects to the ground rail. The 5V wire (red) feeds the + rail, and an orange wire takes it from the + rail to the button's column 4.
The Uno GND on the power header is taken as GND.2. The manual does not say which GND pin.
